senses.gloss:
तक् तक्,
 1. ii. 2, Par. Ātm. ved. To start.
 2. † i. 1, Par. To laugh, or to endure.
तक्र तक्र, i. e. तञ्च् + र n. Buttermilk mixed with water, Man. 8, 326.

तक्ष् तक्ष्, i. 1, Par. (also Ātm.), and ii. 5, तक्ष्णु, Par.
 1. To slice (wood), MBh. 5, 4161.
 2. To cut to pieces, to wound, MBh. 3, 1585.
 3. To prepare, to form (ved.).
 4. † To cover with a hide.
 --With the prep. अनु अनु, To sharpen, Chr. 292, 3 = Rigv. i. 86, 3.
 --With सम् सम्, To cut to pieces, to wound, MBh. 6, 3725.
 --Cf. Lat. tignum; O.H.G. dehsa (an axe), dîhsila; A.S. thixl, thisl; Lat. temo, and probably O.H.G. dahs (a badger); τάσσω; see तक्षन्.
तक्षक तक्ष् + अक m. A cutter, a wood-cutter, Rām. 2, 80, 2.
तक्षण तक्षण, i. e. तक्ष् + अन, n. Planing, Man. 5, 115.

तक्षन् तक्ष् + अन्, m. A carpenter, Man. 4, 210 (read तक्ष्णो वा).
 --Cf. τέκτων.
तक्षशिला तक्षशिला, f. The name of a town, Τάξιλα, Rām. 4, 43, 23.
